column1: # Rare earths: neodymium from samarium ore (GTNH 2.9.0, GTNH-Lanthanides' samarium line), WO-3.3.
# Format: README.md. Crushed samarium ore digests in nitric acid to a muddy solution; nitric acid
# makes the mud, water in the dissolution tank leaves neodymium rare-earth concentrate, which
# hydrochloric acid turns into neodymium oxide, electrolysed to neodymium. The other lanthanides
# of the line (cerium, lanthanum, samarium) come from its byproducts and are left to the
# heuristic. Keys checked against the dev runtime's server harness DB (run 20261106T014148Z).
